verdict.rationale: Cline's docs state that MCP lets it use external tools and data sources through MCP servers (cline-docs-16). The GitHub README says the app manages MCP servers (cline-gh-2, cline-gh-3), and MCP tool calls fall under the auto-approve controls (cline-docs-22), so it clearly acts as an MCP client. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how servers are added and configured (config format, supported transports, any marketplace), independent or hands-on community corroboration of MCP use.
